title: Open and reverse a money movement
problem: A wrong expense or transfer could not be opened or put right, so balances drifted with no trail.
now: Any money row opens a side panel with its details, note and receipts; Reverse asks why and adds a mirror entry.
steps: Open Income & expenses and tap an expense
Press Reverse, write why and confirm
See the Reversal row and the Reversed tag
Open a transfer in Cash, bank & wallets and reverse it: both sides go back
notes: Where: Finances › Cash, bank & wallets (/money) and Finances › Income & expenses (/expenses-bills), tap a row
